Hi Vanessa / Emily,

Thanks for sending the NDA and questionnaire. Quick note on our process: we require the vendor questionnaire completed and reviewed by security before any live demos that include non-public deployment details. The NDA can be executed in parallel but we will need the completed questionnaire and a record of SOC 2 or equivalent before approving a demo that covers private deployment/VPC options.

Please do the following so we can keep to your proposed timeline if possible:
- Return the completed Vendor_Onboarding_Questionnaire.xlsx to procurement@acmehealth.com by Fri Jun 25.
- Provide a link to any SOC 2 report or attestations (or summary).
- If the questionnaire will take longer, please propose alternative demo dates after review (we recommend late next week / early the week after).

Thank you,
Acme Procurement
procurement@acmehealth.com
